decisions.reason: SonicWall SSL-VPN authentication enforcement flaw CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS 7.1, advisory SNWLID-2026-0014) letting attackers bypass SAML authentication and MFA; attach to the existing SonicWall advisory story.

CVE-2026-19868.evidence: gbhackers report on advisory SNWLID-2026-0014: SonicWall PSIRT investigated a report indicating potential exploitation of CVE-2026-19868, signaling suspected malicious activity rather than confirmed in-the-wild exploitation.
